findings.title: Category fabricators deleted and replaced with embeddable_host fabricator
findings.body: category_fabricator.rb now defines only :embeddable_host, and the real :category, :diff_category, :happy_category and :private_category fabricators were moved into embeddable_host_fabricator.rb. The files appear to have been swapped by mistake. Fabricator load order is fine, but the file naming is wrong and confusing. If the fabricators are loaded by filename convention, or either file is later cleaned up, every spec that uses Fabricate(:category) breaks.

findings.title: Migration crashes when the embed_category setting is absent
findings.body: execute(...)[0]['id'] is called on a query result that is empty when no embed_category site setting exists, which is the default because the value was ''. [0] returns nil, so nil['id'] raises NoMethodError and the migration fails on most installs. The uncategorized fallback is never reached. The same applies to the uncategorized_category_id lookup if that row is missing.

findings.title: Unescaped SQL interpolation of host values
findings.body: Host values taken from site settings are interpolated directly into the INSERT with no quoting, so a host containing a quote breaks the migration or allows SQL injection. Values with an http:// prefix or a path are also inserted unnormalized because model callbacks are bypassed. Use connection.quote. Also, blank lines and \r from the split are not stripped.

findings.title: before_validation raises on nil host and mutates in place
findings.body: self.host.sub! is called with no nil check, so a nil host (for example a missing param) raises NoMethodError and returns a 500 instead of a validation error. In-place sub! on the attribute string also mutates it without dirty tracking.

findings.title: Host lookup is case-sensitive on the URI side and ignores ports
findings.body: The query compares lower(host) to uri.host without downcasing the input. URI#host is not lowercased, so a referer such as http://EvilTrout.com never matches. Also, the validation allows a host with a port or path, but the before_validation strips only the path, while the lookup compares against the host without a port, so host entries with ports never match.

findings.title: update and destroy dereference nil when the id is not found
findings.body: EmbeddableHost.where(id:).first returns nil for an unknown id, and then save_host(nil) or nil.destroy raises NoMethodError, giving a 500 instead of a 404. Use find. Also, params[:embeddable_host] being absent raises.

findings.title: Save does not update the host display from the buffer
findings.body: save sends the buffered props, but after success the host's `host` property is only updated if the store applies the server response. Any server-side normalization, such as http:// stripping, depends on the response being applied. Also, cantSave only checks the host is non-empty, so a new host can be saved with no category.

findings.title: update action is a no-op
findings.body: The update action just re-renders the embedding without changing anything. The route and the JS saveChanges call exist but do nothing.

findings.title: replace only swaps the first underscore
findings.body: type.replace('_', '-') uses a string pattern, so only the first underscore is replaced. Types with multiple underscores will not match ADMIN_MODELS.
